scope: Premium Display Case portrait envelope, connected tube geometry, physical label, background, material zones, reveal motion, camera, lighting, accessibility, and mobile performance

decisionLegend.locked: Already approved upstream or locked by an existing product requirement.
decisionLegend.proposed_pending_user_approval: A Gate 03 candidate. It is not approved until the user approves this revision.
decisionLegend.deferred_validation: The contract fixes the test, while the measured result remains for the named downstream gate.

coordinateSystem.y: case height and showcase rotation axis, positive up
coordinateSystem.z: case depth, positive toward the viewer in the authored front view
coordinateSystem.origin: center of the assembled outer envelope
coordinateSystem.showcasePivot: case root at the outer-envelope center; the prize keeps zero independent angular velocity

historicalShippingReference.note: The 50 mm authored body span and 59 mm world envelope describe different extents; Gate 03 must not merge them silently.

candidate.basis: Retain the shipping height and world depth while making the approved analysis proportion exactly 3:4.

topology.path: one cyclic perimeter through four tangent-continuous 90-degree bends
topology.profile: one closed rounded-rectangle profile swept around the cyclic path
topology.channelTest: a flood-fill from any passage sample must visit all four sides and all four bends

candidateCorners.continuity: G1 tangent continuity at every straight-to-bend transition

order: existing official logo and snowflake-like achievement artwork

candidateGeometry.basis: Retain the current physical label size inside the proposed 228 mm case width.

phoneProjection.test: Measure the real shipping phone hero at 100% scale; no conceptual board can pass this test.

approvedUpstream.appearance: continuous low-saturation fine matte friction grain

candidate.tilingRule: No visible seams or local texture islands in the phone hero.

numericPbrTuning.rule: Gate 07 may tune channel values inside these zones, but may not add or merge zones without invalidating Gate 03.

events: assembled real case appears from behind the ready Pack
case root completes one unwrapped 0-to-360-degree turn around Y
case settles at zero angular velocity
case root enters low-frequency hover until explicit acceptance

turnCandidate.easing: sine-in-out over an unwrapped scalar angle

hoverCandidate.owner: case root, never prize mechanism state

compositionRules.label: fully inside the safe frame through the complete turn

environmentRules.subjectIsolation: attenuate broad source-scene light and IBL contamination while retaining environment identity
environmentRules.restoreRule: restore every modified RenderSettings and light property on close or cancellation

candidateRange.exposure: fixed through appear, turn, highlight, and hover

invariants.causalOrder: receipt ready -> real case ready -> Pack handoff -> presentation complete -> explicit acceptance

candidate.turnReplacement: 0.20-second static front-view hold with no case rotation

candidateGateBudget.measurement: Target iPhone Release build; Simulator and static screenshots cannot pass.

route.rodinPolicy: concept-only; prohibited from promotion to Unity
route.shippingAssetPolicy: current shipping asset remains unchanged until downstream gates pass
route.nextGatePolicy: Do not enter Gate 04 before explicit Gate 03 approval.

claimDisposition.display-case-analysis-closed-loop-r002: lock cyclic closed-profile tube topology; proposed section and radii await Gate 03 approval
claimDisposition.display-case-analysis-manifold-r002: lock one connected manifold, zero boundary edges, and full passage flood-fill
claimDisposition.display-case-analysis-background-r002: lock matte low-saturation background language; proposed PBR ranges await Gate 03 approval
claimDisposition.display-case-analysis-label-r002: lock label hierarchy and phone readability; proposed physical and projected sizes await Gate 03 approval
claimDisposition.display-case-analysis-portrait-r002: lock portrait and reject landscape; proposed 228 x 304 x 59 mm envelope awaits Gate 03 approval
claimDisposition.display-case-analysis-flow-r002: lock assembled appear-turn-highlight-hover order; proposed timing and amplitudes await Gate 03 approval
claimDisposition.display-case-analysis-environment-r002: lock environment isolation and no broad color wash; proposed camera and light ranges await Gate 03 approval

validationPlan: The modeling-contract asset and review board both declare all seven active Gate 02 sourceClaimIds.
Gate 05 may not start until every proposed_pending_user_approval item is approved or replaced by a new Gate 03 revision.
Gate 06 must prove one connected manifold, zero open boundary edges, full passage flood-fill, envelope dimensions, radii, wall thickness, and centered Y pivot.
Gate 07 must validate PBR values without changing the locked zone topology.
Gate 08 must sample 0, 90, 180, 270, and 360 degrees and prove one highlight plus zero final angular velocity.
Gate 12 must prove label projection, Reduce Motion, framing, and performance in the real shipping implementation before any phone installation.
approvalQuestion: 是否批准 Gate 03 Rev 1 的整套候选值：228 x 304 x 59 mm 外包络；10 x 9 mm、2 mm 壁厚的单一闭环管；20 mm 外角半径；184 x 58 mm 实体标签；1.8 s Y 轴 360 度；0.55 s 单次高光；正负 2 mm / 3.2 s 悬浮，以及图中 PBR、相机、灯光、Reduce Motion 与性能范围？未明确批准前，这些数值都只是候选。
